text:
Zara: Quick thread to align on CloudCo private offer onboarding across AWS/GCP/Azure. Key open items: IdP SSO, customer-managed KMS support, per-region image manifests, and trial SKU mapping. Who can pick which?

Caleb: I9ll take SSO and publisher perms. Need CloudCo IdP metadata and publisher tenant ID. Will create a minimal staging role.

Rina: I'll own images/manifests + KMS wiring. Note: customers may supply CMK ARNs per region; we must accept external ARNs in the offer. I'll file infra ticket for security review.

Legal-Ann: Legal flagged telemetry language. Marketplace requires explicit opt-in/opt-out phrasing depending on region. Send me the event list (anonymous vs identifying).

Zara: Plan: Caleb = SSO + IAM role, Rina = images + KMS + manifest format, Legal-Ann = EULA snippet + telemetry wording. I'll coordinate CloudCo comms.

Caleb: CloudCo contact: integrations@cloudco.io. Their IdP is SAML. I'll provision a staging role with these minimal actions: s3:PutObject on publisher bucket, ec2:ImportImage, and kms:Encrypt/Decrypt on provided key ARNs. Sample policy snippet: ```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{"Effect": "Allow","Action": ["s3:PutObject", "ec2:ImportImage"],"Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::redwood-marketplace/cloudco/*"}]
}
```

Rina: Manifest format (single-line JSON per region) we'll use: {"cloud":"aws","region":"us-east-1","image":"ami-0abc123","kms":"arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:555:key/aaa"}. We'll store index.json at s3://marketplace-manifests/cloudco/1709999999-index.json and equivalent GS/AZ blobs. Filing INF-5312 for CMK support (ETA 48h).

Legal-Ann: Telemetry draft for listing: "Anonymous usage and error telemetry may be collected to improve service quality. Customers may supply customer-managed keys (CMKs) for image encryption. No PII will be exported without explicit consent." Please confirm event names.

Zara: Product confirms events: app_start, model_infer_latency_ms, sku_redeem, trial_expire, publish_error. Telemetry payload must include sku_id and region and must NOT include user_email or raw request payloads. account_id kept only in internal billing logs.

pub-bot: publisher-portal: CloudCo tenant created. Upload webhook: https://publisher.redwood.ai/hooks/cloudco-1709999999. IdP metadata upload pending.

Caleb: I'll upload staging role ARN by EOD and invite CloudCo to the publisher portal.

Rina: MANIFEST CI jobs: BUILD-AWS-1200, BUILD-GCP-1201, BUILD-AZ-1202. Will push artifacts and index file. Also will add region residency flags for EU/US data placement.

Legal-Ann: I'll attach the marketplace-friendly EULA snippet to the package and cc security on CMK review.

Zara: Great. Next micro-check tomorrow 10:00 PT. If any blocker, post here. :thumbsup:
